allthemodium-364466.intro: ATM10-specific endgame encounter. Drops are from the installed Allthemodium entity loot table; check JEI/EMI for any pack script changes.

bosses.name: Piglich
find: Travel to ATM's The Other dimension and search pyramid structures.
Pigliches are neutral until provoked but have very high health, so bring late-game armor, flight, and a recovery plan.

drops.name: Piglich Heart
drops.use: Endgame Allthemodium material used in ATM progression recipes; JEI/EMI shows the exact ATM10 uses.

special: Piglich Heart is the important reward. Treat it as a progression ingredient, not a generic trophy drop.

l-ender-s-cataclysm-551586.intro: Cataclysm is the densest boss mod in this pack. Its locator eyes and structure names are present in the installed jar.

bosses.name: Ender Guardian
find: Use Cataclysm's Eye of Ruined to locate a Ruined Citadel in The End.
Clear the citadel carefully; the arena is designed for a full boss fight, not a quick mob kill.

drops.name: Gauntlet of Guard
drops.use: Unique Cataclysm weapon/tool reward with guard-themed combat utility.

special: The gauntlet is the special drop. Use JEI/EMI to compare it with the other Cataclysm gauntlets before building around it.

bosses.name: Netherite Monstrosity
find: Use Eye of Monstrous to locate the Soul Black Smith structure in the Nether.
Expect lava, fire damage, heavy melee hits, and arena pressure.

drops.name: Monstrous Horn
drops.use: Rare boss material or combat reward; check JEI/EMI for ATM10 recipes.

drops.name: Lava Power Cell
drops.use: Cataclysm reward item from the entity table.

special: Infernal Forge and Monstrous Horn are the important unique drops from this fight.

bosses.name: Ignis
find: Use Eye of Flame to locate the Burning Arena.
Prepare fire resistance, strong ranged options, and mobility for a long duel.

drops.name: Ignitium Ingot
drops.use: Crafts Cataclysm's Ignitium gear and upgrades.

special: Ignitium is the progression material. It feeds the armor/tool path rather than acting as a simple decoration.

bosses.name: The Harbinger
find: Use Eye of Mech to locate the Ancient Factory.
Bring wither protection or cleansing options and enough damage for a mechanical boss arena.

drops.name: Block of Witherite
drops.use: Compressed Witherite reward used for Cataclysm progression crafting.

special: Witherite is the special reward chain. Break it down or use it in recipes as JEI/EMI indicates.

bosses.name: The Leviathan
find: Use Eye of Abyss to locate the Sunken City.
Fight in or around water; the installed language file notes the Leviathan is invincible outside water.

drops.name: Abyssal Egg
drops.use: Special Leviathan reward item tied to Cataclysm progression.

special: Tidal Claws and Abyssal Egg are the special rewards; keep the fight in water so the boss can actually be damaged.

bosses.name: Ancient Remnant
find: Use Eye of Desert to locate the Cursed Pyramid.
Prepare for desert structure hazards and burst damage.

drops.name: Remnant's Skull
drops.use: Boss trophy-style reward and recipe material where enabled.

special: Sandstorm in a Bottle is the signature special drop.

bosses.name: Kobolediator
find: Use Eye of Storm to locate the Acropolis.
The fight is melee-heavy; clear surrounding mobs before committing.

drops.name: Koboleton Bone
drops.use: Cataclysm material drop used by related recipes.

special: The skull is the unique trophy; Ancient Metal is the practical crafting reward.

bosses.name: Maledictus
find: Use Eye of Curse to locate the Frosted Prison.
Bring cold-area travel supplies, strong armor, and a way to handle curse-themed attacks.
special: Cursium is the special progression material from this fight.

bosses.name: The Prowler
find: Found in Ancient Factory content alongside Cataclysm's mechanical encounter chain.
Use Eye of Mech or an Explorer's Compass search for Cataclysm structures if you need to target it.
special: The installed loot table only shows common drops, so treat this as a dangerous structure encounter rather than a special loot boss.

the-twilight-forest-227639.intro: Twilight Forest bosses are usually progression gates. Follow the biome/structure order or the mod may apply progression protections.

bosses.name: Naga
find: Enter the Twilight Forest and locate a Naga Courtyard.
This is normally the first Twilight Forest boss.

drops.name: Naga Trophy
drops.use: Progression/trophy item used for display and boss completion.

special: Naga Scales are the practical reward; the trophy marks completion.

bosses.name: Twilight Lich
find: Find a Lich Tower after defeating the Naga.
Break through the tower and fight through shield and clone phases.

drops.name: Twilight, Zombie, Life Draining, or Fortification Scepter
drops.use: Magic scepters with combat or defensive spell effects.

drops.name: Ender Pearls, bones, and golden gear

special: The scepter is the special drop; each scepter has a different active effect.

bosses.name: Minoshroom
find: Find a Labyrinth in the Twilight Forest swamp progression area.
Search the lower labyrinth level for the boss room.

drops.name: Meef Stroganoff
drops.use: Progression food used to move into the fire swamp path.

special: Meef Stroganoff is a progression item, not just food.

bosses.name: Hydra
find: Find a Hydra Lair in the Fire Swamp after the swamp progression steps.
Bring fire resistance and ranged damage.

drops.name: Fiery Blood
drops.use: Crafts Fiery equipment and Fiery Ingots.

special: Fiery Blood is the key crafting reward for the Fiery gear path.

bosses.name: Knight Phantom
find: Find a Knight Stronghold in the Dark Forest progression area.
Unlock and clear the stronghold, then fight the phantom group.
special: The Phantom armor pieces are the unique boss rewards.

bosses.name: Ur-Ghast
find: Find the Dark Tower after clearing Dark Forest progression.
Climb to the tower top and use tower ghast traps to control the fight.
special: Fiery Tears are the special crafting reward from the tower boss.

bosses.name: Alpha Yeti
find: Find a Yeti Cave in the Snowy Forest progression area.
Fight in the cave and watch for grab and throw attacks.
special: Alpha Yeti Fur is the progression material toward the Snow Queen path.

bosses.name: Snow Queen
find: Find the Aurora Palace after the snow progression steps.
Climb to the top and fight through ice, flight, and bow phases.

drops.name: Seeker Bow or Tri-Bow
drops.use: Unique bow rewards with special firing behavior.

special: The bow drop is the special reward; Seeker Bow and Tri-Bow play differently.

the-aether-255308.intro: Aether bosses are tied to Bronze, Silver, and Gold dungeon structures in the Aether dimension.

bosses.name: Slider
find: Search the Aether for a Bronze Dungeon.
Mine/attack the Slider according to the dungeon rules, then use the key on the reward chest.

drops.name: Bronze Dungeon Key
drops.use: Opens the Bronze Dungeon reward chest.

special: The key is the actual boss reward because it unlocks the treasure chest.

bosses.name: Valkyrie Queen
find: Search the Aether for a Silver Dungeon.
Collect victory medals from Valkyries, then challenge the Queen.

drops.name: Silver Dungeon Key
drops.use: Opens the Silver Dungeon reward chest.

special: The Silver Dungeon Key unlocks the real loot chest after the fight.

bosses.name: Sun Spirit
find: Search the Aether for a Gold Dungeon.
Reach the boss room and interact/challenge the Sun Spirit.

drops.name: Gold Dungeon Key
drops.use: Opens the Gold Dungeon reward chest.

drops.name: Sun Altar
drops.use: Aether utility block associated with time/daylight control.

special: The Gold Dungeon Key is the progression reward; use it on the dungeon chest.

deeper-and-darker-659011.intro: Deeper and Darker has one major named boss-style encounter in the installed loot tables.

bosses.name: Stalker
find: Enter Deeper and Darker's sculk dimension/content and search sculk-heavy structures or deep areas.
Use Explorer's Compass or the mod's advancements if you need to target the structure in ATM10.
special: Soul Crystal is the important drop from the installed entity loot table.

the-undergarden-379849.intro: The Undergarden's boss progression centers on the Forgotten Guardian.

bosses.name: Forgotten Guardian
find: Enter The Undergarden and find Catacombs/Forgotten Halls progression content.
The installed advancements explicitly track slaying a Forgotten Guardian.

drops.name: Forgotten Nugget
drops.use: Combine into Forgotten Ingots for Forgotten tools and upgrades.

special: Forgotten metal upgrades Cloggrum tools and supports the Forgotten equipment path.

eternal-starlight-1080592.intro: Eternal Starlight uses dimension structures and its in-game book for boss guidance. The structures below are present in the installed worldgen data.

bosses.name: The Gatekeeper
find: Enter Eternal Starlight through portal ruins, then progress until you can challenge the Gatekeeper.
The installed language file includes challenge, rematch, and trade dialogue for this encounter.

drops.name: Trade access / progression
drops.use: Defeating or proving yourself to the Gatekeeper unlocks further interaction and trading.

special: This is a progression encounter more than a normal loot pinata; talk to the Gatekeeper after winning.

bosses.name: Starlight Golem
find: Find a Golem Forge structure in the Eternal Starlight dimension.
The in-game book notes its armor weakens when it stops to absorb energy.

drops.name: Forge/golem progression loot
drops.use: Check the structure chest and JEI/EMI uses for golem-related materials in ATM10.

special: Its special mechanic is defensive armor: disable the energy support when it exposes the weakness.

bosses.name: Lunar Monstrosity
find: Find a Cursed Garden structure in Eternal Starlight.
The in-game book says it loses damage reduction while ignited or stunned.

drops.name: Cursed Garden progression loot
drops.use: Use JEI/EMI and the Eternal Starlight guide book to verify the ATM10 reward path.

special: The important mechanic is its damage reduction. Ignite or stun it before spending your strongest attacks.

the-bumblezone-neoforge-forge-362479.intro: Bumblezone's Queen is more quest/trade encounter than normal boss. The installed loot table exists, but the useful rewards come from interacting with her systems.

bosses.name: Bee Queen
find: Enter The Bumblezone and search hive/queen structure content.
Follow Queen's Desire advancement prompts and interact with the Queen rather than treating her as a normal farm mob.

drops.name: Bee Stinger
drops.use: Bee-themed material used by Bumblezone items and systems.

drops.name: Quest/trade rewards
drops.use: Bonus trades and Queen's Desire rewards are the meaningful progression path.

special: The Queen can request items and grant bonus trade rewards. Killing her is usually less useful than completing her interaction loop.

iceandfire-community-edition-1040076.intro: Ice and Fire adds dangerous world bosses and boss-like legendary creatures. Loot varies by age, type, and sex for dragons.

bosses.name: Fire Dragon
find: Search warm biomes for surface roosts and underground dragon caves.
Higher-stage dragons are more dangerous and are the source of the best materials.

drops.name: Fire Dragon Scales
drops.use: Crafts dragon scale armor and related gear.

drops.name: Fire Dragon Egg
drops.use: Rare female dragon drop used to hatch/tame a dragon.

special: Eggs are the special rare drop and only come from female dragons in the relevant loot table.

bosses.name: Ice Dragon
find: Search cold biomes for roosts and underground dragon caves.
Bring cold resistance, ranged damage, and blocks for terrain control.

drops.name: Ice Dragon Scales
drops.use: Crafts dragon scale armor and related gear.

drops.name: Ice Dragon Egg
drops.use: Rare female dragon drop used to hatch/tame a dragon.

special: Dragon scales and eggs define the Ice and Fire progression loop.

bosses.name: Lightning Dragon
find: Search suitable overworld terrain for lightning dragon roosts and caves.
Expect high burst damage and mobile aerial attacks.

drops.name: Lightning Dragon Scales
drops.use: Crafts dragon scale armor and related gear.

drops.name: Lightning Dragon Egg
drops.use: Rare female dragon drop used to hatch/tame a dragon.

special: Lightning Dragon Eggs and scales are the special rewards.

bosses.name: Cyclops
find: Search for Cyclops caves in the overworld.
The cave commonly contains sheep and the Cyclops itself.

drops.name: Eye of Cyclops
drops.use: Unique Cyclops drop used by Ice and Fire recipes.

special: Eye of Cyclops is the unique reward to keep.

bosses.name: Gorgon
find: Search for Gorgon temples.
Avoid direct line of sight; the Gorgon can petrify unprepared players.
special: Gorgon Head is the special drop. Save it for a high-value target because its use is limited.

bosses.name: Hydra
find: Search swamp-style terrain for Hydra lairs.
Bring fire/poison answers and sustained damage for multiple heads.

drops.name: Hydra Heart
drops.use: Unique Hydra drop and special crafting/progression item.

special: Hydra Heart is the important special drop.

irons-spells-n-spellbooks-855414.intro: Iron's Spells boss encounters unlock magic gear, spell books, and high-tier spell materials.

bosses.name: The Dead King
find: Search Iron's Spells structure progression for the Catacombs/Dead King encounter.
Bring strong magic resistance, ranged options, and sustain.

drops.name: Necronomicon
drops.use: Special spell book for necromancy-themed magic.

special: Blood Staff and Necronomicon are the special magic rewards.

bosses.name: Echo of Tyros, First Flamebearer
find: Search Iron's Spells fire boss structure/progression content.
Bring fire resistance, movement, and enough burst damage for a high-tier caster fight.
special: Divine Soulshard and the unique gear drops are the major reasons to fight Tyros.
